game_title: Digit Mill – Torchlit Cave Mouth Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Torchlit Cave Mouth, the torchlit cave entrance: the torchbearer must handle giant bats while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Digit Mill: Peel digits off a number with while n > 0 using // and %.
theme: Shadow Cave – Torchlit Cave Mouth: the torchlit cave entrance
core_gameplay_loop: In Torchlit Cave Mouth, repeat each round: Peel digits off a number with while n > 0 using // and %. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the digits value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the lantern post using at most 18 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The lantern post reached with actions_used <= 18.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 18 before the lantern post is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 9 (extended tier): Digit Mill
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how digits changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant bats in Torchlit Cave Mouth.
